description: This file defines a client class for interacting with the AWS User Notifications Contacts service, providing method signatures for various contact management operations.

classes.name: NotificationsContactsClient
classes.description: A client class extending AwsClient, designed to interact with the AWS User Notifications Contacts service, offering methods for contact management.

methods.name: activateEmailContact
methods.description: Activates an email contact with the specified arguments.

methods.name: createEmailContact
methods.description: Creates a new email contact with provided parameters.

methods.name: createEmailContactAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new email contact.

methods.name: getEmailContact
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific email contact.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: sendActivationCode
methods.description: Sends an activation code via email.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.
